description: Head-movement mini-game GA06: chin-tuck hold exercise, voice-guided. Tap start, look down once to calibrate the pitch sign, then 8 reps: glide the chin gently straight back (not a nod, not looking down), hold 5 seconds with a spoken 5-4-3-2-1 countdown, relax back to center. A rep counts only in the small 14-20 degree pitch band with the full hold and a return; a full nod beyond 20 degrees counts nothing. AbsoluteOrientationSensor vs a calibrated center; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: chin-tuck
